atomicity.reason: One obligation: accept charging power up to the value.

comprehensibility.reason: Readable on its own; the value is the need's own variant-resolved field.

feasibility.reason: 1000 kW (MCS) and 350 kW (CCS) are achievable with current charging technology.

parent_fit.reason: Charging power acceptance is the key enabler of recharging within a driver break (US_FAST_DEPOT_CHARGING).

unambiguity.reason: 'accept charging power up to' can be read as peak capability or as a sustained charging rate; edge conditions (SoC, temperature) are open.
unambiguity.suggestion: Define the operating window and whether the value is peak or continuous.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out bev condition, same as parent US_FAST_DEPOT_CHARGING; value via variant function <<mcs: 1000 kW, 350 kW>>.

verifiability.reason: Directionally testable against the resolved kW value, but it is unspecified whether this is peak or sustained power and over which SoC/temperature window.
verifiability.suggestion: State peak vs sustained, the SoC window (e.g. 10-80 %) and the ambient/battery temperature conditions.
